Great cakes to be experienced in District 10
Aug 2018 • Couples
My wife and I have been the loyal customers for 4 years since the 1985 cafe firstly established in 2014, we’ve tasted almost every cakes seasonally and they all gave us differences experiences with a variety of cakes, we all loved. 

The taste is great, not so sweet comparing to other cake shops, which all offer a variety of layers in each cake, we love to taste each layer one by one then combining all layers in one bite is so great that we never get bored of

They change the cakes menu by every 2 months with 8-10 type of cakes for each season, for this season, the Matcha Mille Crepes cake is my wife favorite, which basically is crepe with matcha, but the crepe is welldone, not so hard, not so dry, the matcha cream between each layers complete the taste of this crepe. 
On the other hand, Sakura Cheese cake is my favorite, 4 layers of texture: the crushed biscuit-the matcha-the sakura cream and the gelatin layer with a very nice eatable sakura flower in between, I’ve eaten likes 10 sakura cakes in the last two months at least and not meant to stop anyway:)
This coffee shop also famous for their Japanese Latte: Houjicha Latte, Matcha Latte and Kinako Latte, which we usually share in conjunction with the cakes
Recently, the owner have just opened new shop in District 10, (200 To Hien Thanh St, HCM City), the taste is the same but closer to our home, which give us more reason to go to gym by more frequent visit this place:):):)
